analysis.headline: Shares Your Info with Amazon
analysis.quote: We share user information with our parent corporation (Amazon.com, Inc.), the subsidiaries it controls that follow practices at least as protective as those described in this Privacy Notice, and as described below.

analysis.headline: Shares Your Data for Ads
analysis.quote: We provide ad-serving companies, ad networks and advertising companies with information that allows them to serve you with more useful and relevant ads and to measure their effectiveness.

analysis.headline: Collects Your Location Data
analysis.quote: As a result of those actions, you might supply us with such information as: ... your location information; your IP address; ...

analysis.headline: Collects Your Physical Attributes
analysis.quote: As a result of those actions, you might supply us with such information as: ... your physical attributes;

analysis.headline: Tracks Your Content Interactions
analysis.quote: We automatically collect and store certain types of information about your use of IMDb Services, including information about your interaction with content and services available through IMDb Services.

analysis.headline: Retains Your Prior Info Versions
analysis.quote: When you update information, we usually keep a copy of the prior version for our records.

analysis.headline: Collects Your ID Documents
analysis.quote: As a result of those actions, you might supply us with such information as: ... information and documents regarding identity (for example, driver's license numbers).

analysis.headline: Opt-Out Limits Service Use
analysis.quote: You can choose not to provide certain information, but then you might not be able to take advantage of many of our IMDb Services.

analysis.headline: Right to Data Deletion Limited
analysis.quote: Please be advised that IMDb is legally required or entitled to retain some information, such as your content contribution history.
